text.price: $1,976 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 20.
text.record: Prices rose 12% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 13% for developments with similar features in District 20 — about the same as similar developments.

Ai Tong School, about 370 m: 1.9 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.

text.answer: Near an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 20.
